name: Download delivery note
description:
## GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}/delivery_note

Downloads a specific invoice delivery notes
whenToUse: Download one invoice's delivery-note PDF by id; use for the delivery note specifically, not download_invoice_by_invitation for the invoice PDF.

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes
